title: The Constrained Network
description:
**SITUATION:**

You are on the **Fleetline** dispatch team. Soft driver location updates keep the rider map alive — but they are chatty and fat.

On a **constrained** link (limited bandwidth), those soft blobs queue in front of the RPCs that actually move the trip: match, confirm, advance. Riders stare at "Finding your driver…" even though nothing was dropped. Soft traffic starved the strong path.

Fleetline assumed infinite network capacity. It does not.

This lab is **standalone**. You do not implement retries here.

**YOUR TASK:**

Implement `Coalesce` in `internal/location/coalesce.go`.

Drivers stream many `Update` values. Before they compete with trip RPCs for link budget, thin them:

1. Keep at most one update per `DriverID` — the one with the highest `Seq`.
2. Preserve first-seen driver order among distinct drivers.
3. Under spam with duplicate drivers, return a shorter slice than the input.

**SPEC:**

- Newest `Seq` wins per driver
- First-seen order among drivers
- Spam with one driver collapses to a single update
- Empty / nil input → empty output

> **Note:** Graded Submit for this lab is not live yet. Use **Run** (`make test`) in the editor. The Submit harness lands next.

hints: Track the best Update per DriverID and the order drivers first appeared.
When Seq ties or is higher, replace the stored pin for that driver.
Do not invent a retry loop — that is a different lab.
problemStatement.overview: Driver location spam starves trip RPCs on a constrained link. Coalesce soft updates so only the newest pin per driver remains.
problemStatement.brief: Implement Coalesce: newest pin per driver, first-seen order.
